## What changed

Describe the measurement, documentation, report, dashboard, Go/PHP/shell or CI change in 3–5 lines.

## Why this change is needed

Explain how this improves measurement credibility, reproducibility, SLA reporting, timestamp accuracy or operational clarity.

## Validation

- [ ] Go tests passed
- [ ] Go coverage check passed, if relevant
- [ ] Go vet passed
- [ ] Formatting checked
- [ ] Shell/PHP lint passed, if relevant
- [ ] Web links checked, if documentation changed
- [ ] Demo report or generated graph updated, if relevant
- [ ] No private captures, credentials or production configs committed

## Evidence

Link or attach generated reports, plots, logs, manifests or screenshots.

## Risks

What can regress? What assumptions, thresholds, packet fields or timestamp semantics changed?
